title: Measurement of Trans-Epithelial Electrical Resistance with EVOM2 and EndOhm Cup
protocol: Warm cell culture media and DPBS in a 37 °C water bath.
Ensure that the EVOM2 unit is fully charged.
Acquire an additional 12-well plate before starting any measurement.
Adjust the probe height on the EndOhm-12 unit when applicable.
Loosen the locking nut on the cap probe and rotate the cap to adjust the electrode height until it touches the spacer.
For experimental applications, adjust the cap probe electrode to be submerged in apical medium.
Clean the EndOhm-12 by rinsing the cap and chamber with distilled water, then alcohol, and finally distilled water again before reassembling.
Clean the working surface of the biosafety cabinet (BSC) with Cavicide.
Spray the BSC working surface with 70% ethanol and wipe with paper towels.
Allow the surface to air dry before putting materials into the BSC.
Place the EndOhm-12 cup chamber and holding plate into a cleaned BSC.
Add 3.0 mL of warmed cell culture media to the EndOhm-12 cup chamber using a 5 mL serological pipet.
Place the blank insert into the holding plate and add 500 μL of cell culture media to the apical compartment using a P1000 pipette.
Transfer the blank insert into the EndOhm-12 cup chamber.
Check for bubbles underneath the blank insert.
Remove the insert and transfer back into the EndOhm-12 cup to eliminate bubbles.
Place the insert into the EndOhm-12 cup at an angle to minimize bubble formation.
Plug the EVOM2 connecting wires into the EndOhm-12 cup chamber.
Place the assembled EndOhm-12 into a cell culture incubator and close the door.
Switch on the EVOM2.
Wait for the blank resistance readings to stabilize, which should occur within a few seconds.
Switch off the EVOM2 and return the EndOhm-12 to the BSC.
Transfer the blank insert back to the holding plate.
Remove samples from the cell culture incubator and transfer to a BSC.
Transfer three Transwell inserts at a time to be assayed to the holding plate.
Aspirate any medium present in the apical compartment of the Transwell inserts.
Rinse inserts in the holding plate with 500 μL of warmed DPBS using a P1000 pipette.
Add 500 μL of warmed cell culture media to your sample inserts using a P1000 pipette.
Transfer your sample insert into the EndOhm-12 cup chamber.
Check for bubbles underneath the blank insert.
Remove the insert and transfer the insert back into the EndOhm-12 cup to remove any bubbles.
Place the insert into the EndOhm-12 cup at an angle to reduce the frequency of bubbles.
Plug the EVOM2 connecting wires into the EndOhm-12 cup chamber, place the EndOhm-12 into a cell culture incubator, and close the door.
Switch the EVOM2 on.
Monitor resistance readings until they stabilize within 5 minutes.
Switch the EVOM2 off and return the EndOhm-12 to the BSC.
Exchange sample inserts and repeat steps 7-9.
Return the sample insert set from the Holding Plate to the original Sample Plate.
Repeat steps 2-9 with the remaining samples.
Return the EVOM2 unit to its box.
Aspirate all media out of the EndOhm-12 cup chamber.
Rinse both the EndOhm-12 cup chamber and the EndOhm-12 cap probe with ddH2O.
Spray the rinsed components with 70% Ethanol.
Rinse the components one final time with ddH2O.
Ensure no water floods the electronic connection ports.
Allow the EndOhm-12 cup chamber to air dry.
Return the EndOhm-12 Unit to its bubble wrap and storage box.
Test the resistor with the EVOM unit.
Adjust the EVOM unit using a screwdriver if the resistor does not read 1000 Ω.
